unauthorized.text: The API key is missing or wrong. Enter the key again.

request_invalid.text: The publisher could not read this request. Reload the page and try again.

request_too_large.text: The request was too large for the publisher.

unknown_flow.text: This flow is not published. Reload the list.

input_invalid.text: An input value was not accepted. The message below says which input and which rule.

busy.text: The mainframe is busy with another call. Wait a moment and try again.

shutting_down.text: The publisher is shutting down. Try again in a minute.

host_unavailable.text: The publisher could not open a session to the mainframe.

call_timeout.text: The call took too long and was stopped. The mainframe session may still be signed on.

internal_error.text: The publisher failed while running the flow.

timeout.text: The mainframe was too slow to answer a step.

run_timeout.text: The mainframe was too slow for the whole run.

unknown_screen.text: The mainframe showed a screen this flow does not know, so the flow stopped without guessing.

ambiguous_screen.text: The mainframe showed a screen that matches more than one known screen, so the flow stopped.

unexpected_screen.text: The mainframe showed a known screen the flow did not expect at this step, so the flow stopped.

loop_limit.text: A repeated step reached its limit, so the flow stopped.

bad_target.text: A step needed an input field that was not on the screen, so the flow stopped.

secret_target.text: A step tried to type a secret into a field that must not receive it, so the flow stopped.

hidden_output.text: An output would have been read from a hidden field, so the flow stopped.

output_type.text: An output was not of its declared type, so the flow stopped.

screen_size.text: The mainframe screen was not the expected size, so the flow stopped.

session_error.text: The mainframe session failed during the run.

question_invalid.text: The question was not accepted. Use 1 to N characters of plain text.

daily_limit.text: The daily limit of questions has been reached. The count resets at 00:00 UTC and whenever the server restarts.

tool_limit.text: The question needed more steps on the mainframe than this server allows.

turn_limit.text: The AI needed more rounds than this server allows.

ask_timeout.text: The question ran out of time (the limit is 95 seconds at most) and was stopped. No mainframe step was cut off. Try a simpler question.

model_unreachable.text: The AI service could not be reached, or it took too long to answer. Try again in a minute.

model_refused.text: The AI service refused the request. The server settings may be wrong.

model_unusable.text: The AI service answered in a way this server cannot use.

model_busy.text: The AI service is busy. Try again in a minute.

no_response.text: The publisher could not be reached. Check the network or the tunnel and try again.

unreadable_reply.text: The reply did not come from the publisher (for example a proxy error page).

unknown_code.text: The publisher returned an error that this page does not know.

ask_unavailable.text: Ask is not enabled on this server.

ask_reply_unreadable.text: The answer could not be read. Try again.
